pullRequests.title: ✨ Add native OpenTelemetry support
pullRequests.author: tiangolo
pullRequests.body:
✨ Add native OpenTelemetry support

This is designed from the beginning considering OpenTelemetry's contrib current implementation, Logfire, and Sentry.

Several features and data extraction parts in this implementation are there so that these tools can get the data they need, but would currently acquire by monkeypatching FastAPI.

Ideally, no third-party package should need/want to patch FastAPI internals (I'll change and refactor a lot of those internals soon 😅).

---

2026-09-29 update: checked with Sentry and Logfire, this doesn't block or limit their work, we can go with this. A follow up is probably worth with OpenTelemetry contrib to make use the new built-in integration.

## AI Disclaimer

Made with the help of AI, using Codex with `gpt-6-astra`, manually reviewed.
